Frontier Investment Mgmt Company Upped Stake in Apple Computer (AAPL); As Check Point Software Tech LTD Ord (CHKP) Share Value Declined, Ngam Advisors LP Has Decreased Its Stake by $481,833
May 29, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Frontier Investment Mgmt Company increased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 3.96% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Frontier Investment Mgmt Company bought 8,828 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 231,788 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $38.89 billion, up from 222,960 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Frontier Investment Mgmt Company who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $923.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.7346 $187.8454. About 6.83M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Ngam Advisors Lp decreased its stake in Check Point Software Tech Ltd Ord (CHKP) by 3.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ngam Advisors Lp sold 4,867 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.29% with the market. The institutional investor held 139,924 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.90M, down from 144,791 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ngam Advisors Lp who had been investing in Check Point Software Tech Ltd Ord for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.38B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.36 $96.7. About 182,352 shares traded. Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ:CHKP) has declined 12.87% downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.44% the S&P500.
